economy.summary: His campaign says rising grocery prices, gas prices, and high electric bills are hurting seniors, workers, small businesses, and families, and calls for eliminating wasteful government spending; he supports what he calls pro-growth policies to create a job-friendly environment for businesses and opposes regulations, unfunded mandates, and taxes he says crush jobs.
economy.short: Calls for cutting wasteful spending; supports pro-growth, job-friendly policies.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he will not raise taxes on Pennsylvania taxpayers and that he fights against what it calls overregulation and overtaxation.
taxes.short: Says he will not raise taxes on Pennsylvania taxpayers.

abortion.summary: His campaign says he believes in the sanctity of life and supports alternatives such as adoption; he supports parental notification for minors seeking an abortion and opposes public funding of abortions and late-term and partial-birth abortions.
abortion.short: Supports parental notification; opposes public funding, late-term abortions.

education.summary: His campaign says he supports investing in public education and also backs parental choice, including charter schools, homeschooling, vocational training, and education scholarships.
education.short: Supports public education investment and parental school choice options.

guns.summary: His campaign describes him as a strong supporter of the Second Amendment who opposes anti-gun legislation; on public safety, he supports funding for the State Police and local police departments, and opposes sanctuary cities.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment, police funding; opposes anti-gun legislation.

education.summary: Her campaign says some schools in the 125th District rank in the bottom half of Pennsylvania school districts and proposes working together to raise the knowledge and ranking of the district's schools to improve students' educational success.
education.short: Proposes raising district schools' ranking and students' educational success.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign says healthcare is a human right and not a privilege, and that patients and medical professionals must work together to make the best healthcare choices.
healthcare.short: Says healthcare is a human right, not a privilege.
